quarterly_data.quarter: Modine press release: Continued Growth in Data Center Cooling Business Drives 300 (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Modine announced ongoing hiring in southeastern Wisconsin to fill up to 300 positions to support its rapidly growing data center cooling business, across first and second shifts at its Franklin, WI manufacturing facility, citing growing demand for energy-efficient cooling for the expanding U.S. data center market. The Franklin plant, opened in September 2025 at 153,000 square feet, is dedicated to manufacturing Airedale data center cooling systems; the additional workforce is to help ramp up production to meet increasing demand. The Franklin expansion is part of a broader investment announced in July 2025 to increase U.S. manufacturing capacity for Airedale data center cooling products across facilities in Franklin, WI; Grand Prairie, TX; Grenada, MS; and Jefferson City, MO. Modine said it will continue to hire in the coming months until open roles are filled.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 300 positions; Franklin, WI plant 153,000-square-foot, opened September 2025
